title: 'Magyar,' the man leading Ukraine's drone war: 'Drones are the Black Death of the third millennium'
subhead: A former businessman now leading the new unmanned drone corps established by the Ukrainian army, Robert Brovdi became famous for tallying the number of Russian soldiers killed by his brigade and for his graphic videos. title: In Antibes, the unbeatable pan bagnat sandwich from Chez Josy
subhead: 'Gourmet kiosks' (4/6). Across France, small kiosks serving local specialties are a favorite stop for holidaymakers. On La Salis beach in Antibes, Chez Josy has upheld the homemade pan bagnat tradition for 60 years.

title: Searching for Ingmar Bergman's soul on Sweden's Fårö island
subhead: Captivated by the stark beauty of its landscapes, Bergman lived on the small Baltic island and filmed several of his movies there until his death in 2007. Starting at age 60, he also gathered his nine children – born to six different women – at his home on the island. Today, they continue to honor his memory there.
